title: Model
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw the first loop consisting of twelve lines. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0). Continue with the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0426), then the third line from (0.75, 0.0426) to (0.7301, 0.0426). Follow this with the fourth line from (0.7301, 0.0426) to (0.7301, 0.0227), the fifth line from (0.7301, 0.0227) to (0.7131, 0.0227), and the sixth line from (0.7131, 0.0227) to (0.7131, 0.0426). Draw the seventh line from (0.7131, 0.0426) to (0.0369, 0.0426), the eighth line from (0.0369, 0.0426) to (0.0369, 0.0227), the ninth line from (0.0369, 0.0227) to (0.0199, 0.0227), the tenth line from (0.0199, 0.0227) to (0.0199, 0.0426), the eleventh line from (0.0199, 0.0426) to (0.0, 0.0426), and finally the twelfth line from (0.0, 0.0426) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Scale the entire two-dimensional sketch by a factor of 0.75. Rotate the scaled two-dimensional sketch using the same Euler angles and translate it using the same translation vector. Extrude the scaled and transformed two-dimensional sketch 0.017 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The final dimensions of the model are a length of 0.75 units, a width of 0.0426 units, and a height of 0.017 units.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch points
points = [
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.0426),
    (0.7301, 0.0426),
    (0.7301, 0.0227),
    (0.7131, 0.0227),
    (0.7131, 0.0426),
    (0.0369, 0.0426),
    (0.0369, 0.0227),
    (0.0199, 0.0227),
    (0.0199, 0.0426),
    (0.0, 0.0426),
    (0.0, 0.0)
]

# Create the sketch
r = r.polyline(points).close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.017)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
L = 0.7500   # along X
W = 0.0426   # along Y
H = 0.0170   # along Z

# Notch dimensions
notch_len = 0.020   # along X
notch_depth = 0.020 # along Y

# Base bar
r = cq.Workplane("XY").box(L, W, H, centered=(False, False, False))

# Cut notch at left end (from +Y side)
r = r.cut(
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(0.0, W - notch_depth, 0))
    .box(notch_len, notch_depth, H, centered=(False, False, False))
)

# Cut notch at right end (from +Y side)
r = r.cut(
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .transformed(offset=(L - notch_len, W - notch_depth, 0))
    .box(notch_len, notch_depth, H, centered=(False, False, False))
)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Long flat bar: 0.750 (X) x 0.0426 (Y) x 0.0170 (Z)
# Top view shows a small rectangular notch cut into one long edge near each end.

L = 0.7500   # length along X
W = 0.0426   # width along Y
T = 0.0170   # thickness along Z

# Notch dimensions (estimated from views)
notch_w = 0.008   # along X
notch_d = 0.008   # depth into Y
end_off = 0.006   # distance of notch from each end along X

# Build the outline (XY plane, top view). Notches on the back edge (y = W).
pts = [
    (0, 0),
    (L, 0),
    (L, W),
    (L - end_off, W),
    (L - end_off, W - notch_d),
    (L - end_off - notch_w, W - notch_d),
    (L - end_off - notch_w, W),
    (end_off + notch_w, W),
    (end_off + notch_w, W - notch_d),
    (end_off, W - notch_d),
    (end_off, W),
    (0, W),
]

r = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline(pts).close().extrude(T)
